prompt: Install the Engineer Pack so the execute family can close a branch.
assertions: this folder is a registered Engineer Pack skill so npx skills add copies it beside the execute-family skills
the controller loads this file when an execute-family Setup or After-last step says to

prompt: The last task just ledgered complete. Close the branch.
assertions: polish runs only when a polish predicate holds
EOD or a clean inspect is not treated as a reason to skip a 40-file branch
a skip must be written skip: no polish predicate

prompt: Last task is complete. Inspect was clean. Don't ping me with another slash command. Just land it. Diff is src/auth/session.ts.
assertions: /select-review-sample is not named in execute-common (land-branch is the station)
the sample notes line is not silently omitted

prompt: Close a one-file README typo. Always name a sample so we cannot forget.
assertions: Close notes include skip: no sample predicate
always name so we cannot forget is not treated as asked

derived_from: TESTS.md § Product-walk predicate v1.4.0 — clauses added for review-ui needs-human-eyes and new user-facing screens
prompt: Close sequence: the branch added a brand-new settings screen; review-ui reported needs-human-eyes: none. Evaluate the walk predicate.
assertions: the product-walk predicate evaluates true because the branch adds a new user-facing screen
a branch only restyling existing surfaces with needs-human-eyes: none does not trip these clauses
